items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee refers to 'Harold' as a sibling ('I didn't take Harold', 'Harold was in school about three years or so behind me') and later mentions 'Harold Arlen' in the context of New York stars ('So there was Harold Arlen and Ethel Waters...'). The text does not describe a professional or person

ctx.x: you had -- from Pasadena to Los Angeles is how far, about ten miles, 12 miles?
Well, in fact I did it alone. I didn't take Harold. Harold wasn't that interested. And we used to catch the red car -- called the red car down ON Fair Oaks -- and ride over.
You'd take the great big street car.
